_about: The families of flagged issues, read by the board's problem filter through board/families.py, which states how an issue is matched to a family and which issues count. An issue belongs to the first family below whose tags, names (the plain names in tag_names.json) or text it matches, else to a family named after its tag. Order matters only where two families could claim the same issue (a blur patch the model filed as a camera fault is privacy blur). checks names deterministic check flags that raise the family, completion the outcomes that raise it, and datasets limits a family to those datasets.

families.why: the model files several problems under one tag, camera_fault; each is claimed by its words: glare (low-light, first, since glare also obscures), a camera taken off, turned away or covered (this family), and a frozen or lost image (camera-image). Anything else keeps the tag's own name
